extracted.name: Vodka punch
extracted.description: Ideal for parties, this punch is easy to put together, simple to serve and filled with crowd-pleasing fruity flavours
instruction_lines: Pour the vodka and triple sec into a large punch bowl. Mix the lime juice and sugar together in a glass or jug until the sugar has dissolved, then add that to the bowl.
Pour in the fruit juices, then add lots of ice and stir. Pour in the sparkling water, mint, sliced fruit mint and berries.
